story.text: 승객 여러분, 좌측 창문을 보시면 서울을 가로지르는 큰 물줄기가 보이실 거예요. 오늘은 서울의 하늘과 강을 함께 즐겨봐요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, jwa-cheuk chang-mun-eul bo-si-myeon seo-ul-eul ga-ro-ji-reu-neun keun mul-jul-gi-ga bo-i-sil geo-ye-yo.
story.en: Passengers, if you look out the left window, you'll see a great river cutting through Seoul. Today let's enjoy Seoul's sky and river together.

story.text: 저게 바로 '한강'이에요. 서울 시민들의 진짜 앞마당 같은 곳이죠.
story.reading: jeo-ge ba-ro han-gang-i-e-yo. seo-ul si-min-deul-ui jin-jja ap-ma-dang gat-eun gos-i-jyo.
story.en: That's the 'Han River'. It's like the real front yard of Seoul's citizens.

story.text: 저 멀리 높이 솟은 탑이 'N서울타워'예요. 서울의 야경을 한눈에 담을 수 있는 명소죠.
story.reading: jeo meol-li nop-i sos-eun tab-i en-seo-ul-ta-wo-ye-yo.
story.en: That tall tower in the distance is 'N Seoul Tower'. It's a landmark where you can take in Seoul's night view at a glance.

story.text: N서울타워까지는 '케이블카'를 타고 올라갈 수 있어요. 남산 풍경을 즐기며 편하게 이동해요.
story.reading: en-seo-ul-ta-wo-kka-ji-neun ke-i-beul-ka-reul ta-go ol-la-gal su i-sseo-yo.
story.en: You can ride a 'cable car' up to N Seoul Tower, enjoying the scenery of Namsan along the way.

story.text: 한강공원에서는 '자전거'를 빌려서 강바람을 맞으며 달려볼 수도 있어요.
story.reading: han-gang-gong-won-e-seo-neun ja-jeon-geo-reul bil-lyeo-seo gang-ba-ram-eul maj-eu-myeo dal-lyeo-bol su-do i-sseo-yo.
story.en: At the Han River Park, you can also rent a 'bicycle' and ride along, feeling the river breeze.

story.text: 그리고 N서울타워의 '전망대'에 오르면, 서울 시내 전체가 발아래 펼쳐진답니다.
story.reading: geu-ri-go en-seo-ul-ta-wo-ui jeon-mang-dae-e o-reu-myeon, seo-ul si-nae jeon-che-ga bal-a-rae pyeol-cheo-jin-dam-ni-da.
story.en: And when you go up to the 'observatory' of N Seoul Tower, all of downtown Seoul unfolds beneath your feet.

story.text: 자, 이제 오늘 배운 다섯 단어로 서울의 스카이라인을 완성해볼까요?
story.reading: ja, i-je o-neul bae-un da-seot dan-eo-ro seo-ul-ui seu-ka-i-la-in-eul wan-seong-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Now, shall we complete Seoul's skyline with today's five words?

words.example: 강을 따라 자전거길이 잘 조성되어 있습니다.
words.example_reading: gang-eul tta-ra ja-jeon-geo-gil-i jal jo-seong-doe-eo it-seum-ni-da
words.example_en: There is a well-developed bike path along the river.
If you go up the tower, you can see the whole city below.
You take a cable car up Namsan.
You can rent a bicycle at the Han River.
You can see all of downtown Seoul from the observatory.

sentences.en: Enjoy a walk at Han River Park.
N Seoul Tower is Seoul's iconic landmark.
The view from the cable car is fantastic.
Try riding a bicycle along the Han River.
You take in Seoul's night view from the observatory.
